name: @school-pulse/owner-auth
description: Canonical, single-source-of-truth Platform Owner authorization for School Pulse Cloud Functions. Consumed as a local file: dependency by BOTH Firebase Functions codebases (functions/ and public_functions/ - see repo-root firebase.json's two `codebase` entries) so there is exactly one implementation of "is this authenticated UID the seeded SaaS Owner" in the entire backend, never two independently-maintained copies that can drift apart.
